input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Admin, User roles. The platform provides capabilities for distributed lock manager, redis distributed lock manager. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include authentication functionality.

user_stories.story: As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
